original_record.question:
What is the volume of a pyramid whose base is one face of a cube of side length $2$, and whose apex is the center of the cube? Give your answer in simplest form.

explicit_conditions: Cube edge2; pyramid base one cube face and apex cube center.
layout_choices: Frozen 3D apex(1,1,1), base z0; rear-edge occlusion intersection computed in projection.
